cap: Four benign conditions are told apart by setting and histology: acute mastitis in nursing mothers, periductal mastitis in smokers with keratin-plugged ducts, duct ectasia in older multiparous women, and fat necrosis after trauma, which calcifies and mimics carcinoma. Implants add capsular contracture, silicone granuloma and, rarely, CD30-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma around textured implants.
